Akali.build: Akali’s damage is mostly magic, so build Spectre’s Cowl between core items to increase your magic resistance. Akali’s high magic resistance can blunt Tahm Kench’s main source of magic damage, so consider penetration or damage that is unaffected by magic resistance.
Akali.combo: When Akali leaves Akali W Twilight Shroud and becomes visible, stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If she has two stacks, stun her with the next Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, then follow with Tahm Kench R Devour once Akali’s escape is down. Against a distant Akali, you can also press R while Q is in flight to try to Devour her the moment Q hits.
Akali.escape: If Akali has used only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip, she can escape with the mobility spell she has left, so do not rush your engage. Your chance to catch her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive comes after both spells are down and before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up.
Akali.fight: Do not force an engage without any stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste. Build stacks with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, then pressure Akali. If Akali still has a mobility spell available, do not engage hastily with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Akali.laning: If Akali steps up to last-hit while she has two stacks, look to stun her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash.
Akali.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build health items, both Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and the amount of damage stored by Tahm Kench E Thick Skin increase, so stay with your allies.
Akali.teamfight: Stay by your carry and watch for Akali’s engage with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. Use Tahm Kench R Devour to protect your ally just before Akali’s finishing attack lands, then peel her off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.

KSante.fight: While Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks remain, trade briefly with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Save your stun and damage while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, and move out of the dash’s path. When K'Sante R All Out is active and he becomes more vulnerable, focus your team’s damage on him, but don’t face him alone for long.
KSante.build: Build health items first to increase both Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and durability. Build armor against K'Sante’s main damage, and rely on health against true damage. If crowd control gets you killed, you can prioritize tenacity over resistances.
KSante.combo: Build two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks, then land the third with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to stun him. Follow with Tahm Kench R Devour, or, when he has two stacks, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling to swallow him from a distance. Before starting with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, make sure you’re in a position to reliably land the knockup.
KSante.escape: Don’t engage just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down. Check whether he can still use K'Sante E Footwork and R All Out, and look especially for a chance to catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive before K'Sante R All Out comes back up. If K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes’ empowered shockwave is ready, create distance first to avoid its forced movement.
KSante.laning: If K'Sante steps up to last-hit while he has two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and add a basic attack. After taking damage, decide whether you need Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s shield. If the fight is over, use the reserve to heal.
KSante.phase: K'Sante gets stronger in lane as he builds defensive items, so it’s best not to miss early trading opportunities.
KSante.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for K'Sante W Path Maker, E Footwork, and R All Out to engage. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour just before K'Sante’s finishing attack reaches them, then peel K'Sante away with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive after spitting your ally out. Focus your team’s damage on K'Sante during R All Out. If the fight will be prolonged, make sure your team has access to anti-healing.
KSante.watch: If you’re hit by consecutive casts of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, move out of range of the next shockwave. If you see K'Sante W Path Maker charging, sidestep and respond with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash after the dash ends. Don’t stand with terrain behind you during a standoff, so K'Sante R All Out can’t push you over a wall.

Aurora.teamfight: Stay beside your carry and watch for Aurora to engage with Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, and Aurora R Between Worlds. Use Tahm Kench R Devour to protect your ally before Aurora’s finishing attack reaches them, then peel her off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If Aurora dives in and no one is killed, use that moment as a chance to catch her.
Aurora.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Aurora’s main damage and fit Spectre’s Cowl between your core items. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora’s escape is down and you have a clear angle, knock her up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Once she has two stacks, stun her with the next Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and use Tahm Kench R Devour when you can hold her safely. If there is distance between you, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is in flight toward Aurora with two stacks to try to Devour her from range.
Aurora.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Aurora W Across the Veil alone is down. Your chance to catch her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive comes after Aurora E The Weirding is also down and before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up. If Aurora uses Aurora W Across the Veil to become invisible, do not waste your spells; wait for her to reappear.
Aurora.fight: Do not force an engage without any stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste. Pressure Aurora while building stacks with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Your chance to engage comes after Aurora has used both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding. Use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive when you can hit it. After taking a big hit, activate Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next hit lands to gain a shield.
Aurora.laning: When Aurora steps up to last-hit, if she has two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, stun her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack. When your health is low, use the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, but do not stay in range while Aurora Q Twofold Hex is on you.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Tahm Kench is not much of a threat before building stacks, so choose your fights against Aurora carefully. In the mid to late game, as you build health items, Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and the amount of damage stored by Tahm Kench E Thick Skin increase, so move with your allies.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases the lower your health is. If you are cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora; if your health is marginal, back away before the recall. After Aurora R Between Worlds appears, leaving it slows you, so decide whether to dodge before the zone forms or fight inside it.

Singed.combo: Use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to knock Singed up in an area not covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive. Stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks, then apply the third stack with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to stun him before following up with Tahm Kench R Devour. Tahm Kench is vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so use it where your allies can finish them immediately or somewhere safe, such as under a turret.
Singed.build: Fit Spectre’s Cowl between your core items and prioritize magic resistance. Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling deal magic damage, and E scales with your maximum health, so don’t counter them by stacking health alone. Also build some movement speed to help you get out of poisoned areas.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability that creates distance on its own, so avoiding Singed W Mega Adhesive and waiting until Singed E Fling is down creates an opening to engage. Then catch him with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Singed.fight: Avoid Singed W Mega Adhesive, then engage once Singed E Fling is down. Stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to look for a stun. Use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to engage when you can land it. If Singed leaves poison behind as he runs, stop chasing unless you have enough damage to finish him for sure.
Singed.laning: Instead of chasing recklessly, stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks when Singed steps up to last-hit, then stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash at two stacks to chip away at his health. Pressure him early and force him to recall to reduce how often he can keep pushing the lane once he has his core items.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes difficult to catch once he has his core items, so don’t chase through his poison or take a reckless fight.
Singed.teamfight: Stay near your allied carry. If Singed dives in, lock him down with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive so his allies can be attacked in the meantime. If your carry is in danger, protect them early with Tahm Kench R Devour and make use of the shield they receive after you spit them out. Don't chase Singed so far that you step through Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.watch: Don't chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. Detour around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive, and watch behind Singed so Singed E Fling doesn't throw you toward the enemy team. While Singed R Insanity Potion is active, his poison applies Grievous Wounds, so don't rely solely on healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to stay alive.

Kennen.watch: Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks twice, back away to avoid a third hit and the stun. In teamfights, spread out so Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom does not hit multiple allies.
Kennen.build: Most of Kennen’s damage is magic, so fit Spectre’s Cowl between core items to build magic resist. Since Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s reserve scales with damage taken, magic resist also gives you more time to survive and use that reserve.
Kennen.combo: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and you can build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, land the third stack with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash after two basic attacks to stun him. Follow with Tahm Kench R Devour if you can safely finish Kennen from your position. If Kennen has two stacks and moves away, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling.
Kennen.escape: After Kennen comes in with Kennen E Lightning Rush, you have a chance to counterattack. Build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks and look for a stun with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to engage only when you can reliably hit Kennen. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has two stacks, back away first and wait for them to expire.
Kennen.fight: Close the gap and fight after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. Slow him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and weave in basic attacks to stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste. After taking heavy damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next hit lands to gain a shield.
Kennen.laning: Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions and step forward briefly only to last-hit. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks, stun Kennen with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash when he steps up to last-hit. If you have no stacks, don’t force an engage; use the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash.
Kennen.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build health items, your basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s reserve both grow, so stay close to your allies.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out so Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom does not catch multiple allies, and stay beside your allied carry. When Kennen engages on your carry, protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour just before he lands the finishing blow. Then keep Kennen away from your carry with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knockup from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.

Yasuo.escape: Look to engage right after Yasuo throws his tornado and before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a short-cooldown dash, so don’t go in just because he used it once; wait until you can lock him down with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first to block the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Tahm Kench can increase both his durability and basic attack damage with health items. Keep in mind that armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Engage when Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive can reliably knock him up, then stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Applying the third stack with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash stuns him, and an enemy with stacks can be swallowed with Tahm Kench R Devour. Tahm Kench is also vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so use it when your allies can finish them immediately or when you’re in a safe spot.
Yasuo.fight: Start trading after removing Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke. Don’t force an engage without Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks; pressure him with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash while your stacks are active. Go in when Yasuo has just thrown his tornado and temporarily has no way to knock you up.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can dash through with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When dodging Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, move sideways instead of only backing up. If Yasuo steps up to last-hit while you have two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks on him, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack.
Yasuo.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build health items and your basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s stored gray health increase, fight alongside your allies.
Yasuo.teamfight: Guard your allied carry and be ready for Yasuo to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or Yasuo R Last Breath. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before the finishing attack lands, then use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to keep Yasuo away. After taking heavy damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next attack lands.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, watch for the next Q tornado and a Yasuo R Last Breath combo. When you hear the tornado preparation sound and see its effects, move out of its line and dodge to the side. Save Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash while facing Yasuo W Wind Wall, and wait for the wall to disappear or for an angle to go around it.

Aatrox.phase: If you farm and avoid giving up early kills, the matchup gets easier as the game goes on.
Aatrox.escape: The window for Tahm Kench to engage is right after you bait out Aatrox E Umbral Dash. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, leave its area first to avoid being pulled in. Keep your distance while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first against Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains, his main sources of damage. Then build health items to increase both Tahm Kench’s durability and empowered basic attack damage. If the duel goes long, get Grievous Wounds to counter Aatrox’s healing.
Aatrox.combo: When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down and you can land Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, knock him up and stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks. If there are already two stacks, land Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as the third hit to stun him, then follow with Tahm Kench R Devour. If the distance between you has widened, you can Devour Aatrox with stacks from range by pressing Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is in flight.
Aatrox.fight: Look for a trade right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. Dodge the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade while stacking Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, close the gap with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, focus on farming and avoid giving up kills instead of forcing trades. When Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks and Aatrox steps up to last-hit, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack. After taking damage, convert the damage stored by Tahm Kench E Thick Skin into a shield just before the next big hit, or let it restore your health between fights.
Aatrox.teamfight: Stay by your carry and watch for the moment Aatrox closes in with Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Use Tahm Kench R Devour to swallow and protect your ally before Aatrox’s finishing attack lands, then peel him off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main damage and knock-up, so when you see the cast, dodge outside the blade’s edge or move in close. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately instead of stopping to choose a direction. While Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing is increased, so avoid dueling him and wait for its duration to end.

Camille.escape: Tahm Kench’s chance to engage comes after you dodge Camille E Hookshot’s stun and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is down. Camille can use both mobility abilities together to escape, so don’t rush after her when only one is down.
Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. Camille Q Precision Protocol deals true damage that resistances cannot reduce, so you also need health; however, Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Camille.combo: Once Camille’s shield has been removed, if you can reliably hit Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, knock her up with W, stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks, then land Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as the third stack to stun her. If she already has two stacks, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is in flight to Devour her from range the moment Q hits.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. Fight and stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste after the shield has been removed.
Camille.laning: Early on, stand among minions and away from walls to limit Camille E Hookshot’s engage angles. When Camille steps up to last-hit while she still has two stacks on her, look to stun her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and pressure her during her weak period before her first core item.
Camille.phase: From the mid game onward, leaving Camille alone in a side lane can lead to losses at your turrets. Tahm Kench gets strong in the mid to late game as he builds health items, so move with your allies and focus on protecting them.
Camille.teamfight: Stay beside your carry and watch for Camille E Hookshot or R The Hextech Ultimatum to engage. Use Tahm Kench R Devour to protect your ally just before Camille’s finishing attack reaches them, then peel her off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot lets her engage from a distance using a wall and stun you, so stand away from walls and watch for her hookshot path. Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum makes her untargetable as she engages, so do not waste Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or W Abyssal Dive during that moment.

DrMundo.teamfight: Tahm Kench stays beside his allied carry and watches for Dr. Mundo to engage. If the carry is in danger, protect them with R Devour before a finishing attack can reach them, then use Q Tongue Lash’s slow and W Abyssal Dive to peel him off. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, protect your allies and look for another target instead of chasing him for long.
DrMundo.build: Dr. Mundo’s main damage is the physical damage from E Blunt Force Trauma, so build armor first. Watch for the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and W Heart Zapper as well; if the duel goes long, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances. Health items also help Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and the damage stored by E Thick Skin.
DrMundo.combo: Build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. After three stacks, the stun from the first Q Tongue Lash can be blocked by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, so confirm his passive is down before knocking him up with W Abyssal Dive. Even if you have enough stacks to Devour Dr. Mundo, use R Devour only when an ally can kill him immediately or when you are in a safe position.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no spell to create distance on his own, so once Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and you have an angle, catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. If W Abyssal Dive misses, you lose both your engage and escape for a long time, so use it only when you can hit it.
DrMundo.fight: While Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it ignores the first immobilizing effect, so trigger it first and then catch him with your next crowd control. Once you are on him, build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. After taking a big hit, use E Thick Skin just before additional damage lands. Look for a kill during the window when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down.
DrMundo.laning: Dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw by keeping minions between you and him, and walk over the canister he drops after a trade to break it. When Dr. Mundo steps up to last-hit with two stacks on him, look for an angle to land Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash.
DrMundo.phase: As levels increase, Dr. Mundo’s magic resistance rises significantly, reducing your early advantage, while Tahm Kench gets stronger in the mid to late game as he builds health items. While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available, look for gains in other lanes or around objectives instead of spending time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target it contacts and deals more damage when your current health is higher, so stand behind minions when you have a lot of health. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma increases his attack damage and empowers his basic attacks, so do not stay close and take repeated hits. Do not insist on getting a kill while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is healing him and increasing his movement speed.

Skarner.escape: The window for Tahm Kench to engage is right after Skarner uses E Ixtal's Impact. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact knocks you into a wall, his re-engage comes sooner, so account for his next dash and back off instead of following immediately. Also watch your positioning around short range if Skarner R Impale is still available.
Skarner.build: Decide in advance whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar against the suppression from Skarner R Impale. For resistances, prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about relying on health alone.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. At two stacks, use your next Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to land the third stack and a stun, pressing Tahm Kench R Devour while your tongue is still in flight to look for a long-range swallow. Tahm Kench is vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so only finish them this way if your allies can immediately take them down or you're in a safe position.
Skarner.fight: After you make Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, you have a chance to close the distance. Slow him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, but only use W to engage when you can land it. After taking damage, activate Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next big hit lands.
Skarner.laning: When Skarner has two stacks and steps forward to last-hit, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack. Don't stand with your back to a wall, to reduce the angles for Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to lead into a stun.
Skarner.phase: Skarner’s damage also increases with tank items, so it’s important to gain control of early objectives and delay his item timings.
Skarner.teamfight: Stay near your allied carry and watch for Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to connect. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before a lethal hit lands. After spitting them out, use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to keep Skarner away. Skarner R Impale ignores terrain and drags its target, so don’t stand right beside the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, and a collision with a wall leads into a stun. Don't stand with your back to a wall, and keep out of range of Skarner R Impale, which has a short range. If Skarner catches you, his empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval keep dealing damage, so avoiding the initial catch is key.

Chogath.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Cho’Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes, and fit Spectre’s Cowl between your core items. Tahm Kench E Thick Skin stores damage taken, so magic resistance also gives you more time to use that stored damage. Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes scales with your maximum health, and resistance does not mitigate the true damage from R Feast, so avoid building only health.
Chogath.combo: Engage after Cho’Gath Q Rupture and W Feral Scream are down, when you can land Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with two basic attacks, then land Q Tongue Lash as the third hit to stun him before following with R Devour. If he already has two stacks, press R Devour while Q Tongue Lash is in flight to Devour him from range the moment Q hits.
Chogath.escape: Engage during a window when Cho’Gath has used Q Rupture on the wave or both Q Rupture and W Feral Scream are down. Cho’Gath has no mobility spell, so it is hard for him to create distance if he is hit by the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive. If W Abyssal Dive misses, you lose both your engage and escape for a long time, so only use it when you have a clear angle.
Chogath.fight: Start trading after dodging the warning from Cho’Gath Q Rupture sideways and leaving the frontal area of W Feral Scream. While Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks are active, pressure him with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. If you have no stacks, do not force an engage. After taking damage, turn Tahm Kench E Thick Skin into a shield just before the next big hit lands.
Chogath.laning: Stand out of the line where Cho’Gath attacks minions to avoid poke from E Vorpal Spikes passing through them. Pressure Cho’Gath or look for a gank right after he uses Q Rupture on the wave to delay his early stack growth.
Chogath.phase: Early on, push the lane or pressure Cho’Gath to limit his chances to build stacks.
Chogath.teamfight: Stay by your carry and stop Cho’Gath’s engage. Use Tahm Kench R Devour to protect your ally just before a finishing ability like Cho’Gath R Feast lands. After spitting your ally out, peel Cho’Gath off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive. Once you have stored damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin before the next big hit lands.
Chogath.watch: Cho’Gath Q Rupture has a visible warning on the ground, so dodge sideways as soon as you see it. Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences in front of him, making the follow-up Q Rupture harder to dodge, so do not start trades head-on. Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes deals damage based on your maximum health and passes through minions, so step out of the line where Cho’Gath is basic attacking. If your health is at or below half, get out of range of Cho’Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius P Hemorrhage, Q Decimate, and W Crippling Strike. Darius E Apprehend’s penetration bypasses some armor, and R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so get health as well. Bonus health also helps Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage.
Darius.combo: When Darius E Apprehend is down, knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive and build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with two basic attacks, then land Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as the third hit to stun him. Follow with Tahm Kench R Devour when you can safely finish him. If Darius is at a distance with two stacks, press R while Q is in flight to Devour him from range the moment it hits.
Darius.escape: Engage with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive when Darius E Apprehend has been used into empty space or is on cooldown. If W misses, you also lose your escape, so only engage when you have a clear angle.
Darius.fight: Trade briefly and back off after Darius E Apprehend misses or is down. Poke with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash right after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions. Once Darius P Hemorrhage starts stacking, stop the extended fight and engage again after the stacks expire.
Darius.laning: Keep stacks up with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, then look to stun Darius with Q when he steps up to last-hit with two stacks. When your health is low, use the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and after taking damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next big hit lands.
Darius.phase: Early on, Tahm Kench’s threat from stacks is weak and Darius is strong in brawls, so survive with short trades. During this period, move with your allies instead of trying to finish fights alone.
Darius.teamfight: Stay by your carry and stop Darius from approaching with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive. Use Tahm Kench R Devour to protect your ally just before Darius R Noxian Guillotine hits them, and use W to pull them out of danger if needed. Do not remain in a fight with bleed stacks and let Darius get a kill that resets R.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you are likely to take follow-up attacks, so poke from outside its range and save Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive until E is down. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up, create distance to break the stacks. When Darius Q Decimate appears, move outside the axe blade or stay close to him. Once several bleed stacks are on you, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Fiora W Riposte or the true damage from P Duelist’s Dance and R Grand Challenge. Health also helps Tahm Kench’s damage and durability, but Fiora R Grand Challenge scales with your maximum health, so do not stack only health. If the duel goes long, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Fiora.combo: If Fiora W Riposte is down, build two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with two basic attacks, then land Q Tongue Lash as the third hit to stun her and follow with R Devour. If there is distance between you, while two stacks are still on her, press Tahm Kench R Devour as Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is in flight to Devour her from range the moment it hits. If starting with W Abyssal Dive, wait until Fiora Q Lunge is down and she cannot block the knock-up with Riposte.
Fiora.escape: Right after Fiora Q Lunge is down is your window to close the gap with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or engage with W Abyssal Dive. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, it is harder for her to block the stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive, so engage then.
Fiora.fight: Stand opposite the exposed vital and briefly counterattack when Fiora moves in to target it. After Fiora Q Lunge and W Riposte are down, build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. When engaging with W Abyssal Dive, make sure you have a clear position to hit it. After taking a big hit, turn the gray health from Tahm Kench E Thick Skin into a shield just before the next hit lands.
Fiora.laning: Stand opposite the vital, and counterattack using your active stacks when Fiora steps up to last-hit or dives in with Q Lunge. After a short trade, do not chase Fiora recklessly. When your health is low, use the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the gray health from E Thick Skin.
Fiora.teamfight: Stay by your carry and watch for Fiora Q Lunge to engage. Use Tahm Kench R Devour to protect your ally before Fiora reaches them and finishes them, then peel her off with the slow from Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall to prevent her from popping all four vitals.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks the stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive; if it blocks an immobilizing effect, it stuns you instead. Do not use either spell recklessly while Riposte is available, and move sideways when casting to avoid its hit. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall so she cannot hit all four vitals.

Gangplank.build: Build armor first starting in lane to reduce the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. Resistance doesn’t reduce the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, so build health too. Health also increases Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage.
Gangplank.combo: When Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down and you can land Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, knock him up, then land two basic attacks to build two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste and stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Follow up with Tahm Kench R Devour. If he’s at two stacks and gets some distance, press R while Q is traveling so you can Devour him from afar as Q hits.
Gangplank.escape: Engage just after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg, while no keg is primed and Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down. Gangplank has no skill to create distance on his own, so close in and build stacks if you’re sure Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive will hit. If W misses, you lose both your engage and escape for a while, so save it when you don’t have a clear angle.
Gangplank.fight: Trade when Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed and hasn’t primed yet.
Gangplank.laning: Back off when Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, and look to trade right after he places one. Build armor early to handle Gangplank Q Parrrley’s poke, and manage your health with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash’s healing and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin.
Gangplank.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build health items, both Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s stored health increase. Play close to your allies.
Gangplank.teamfight: Stay near your allied carry and watch for primed Gangplank E Powder Kegs and where Gangplank R Cannon Barrage lands. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour just before the finishing damage hits, then spit them out so they gain the shield. Follow up with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to peel approaching enemies.
Gangplank.watch: When Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, move out of its blast radius, and don’t stand where two kegs overlap. You can destroy a keg yourself from outside its range. Also watch out for the constant poke from Gangplank Q Parrrley and the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire.

Garen.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so build health too instead of relying on resistance. Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste’s basic attack damage also scales with bonus health.
Garen.combo: Start your combo after Garen Q Decisive Strike is down and the shield and tenacity from Garen W Courage have worn off. Against a target with two stacks, you can press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tongue Lash is traveling to Devour them from range.
Garen.escape: Engage during the window when Garen Q Decisive Strike’s silence has been used up. Garen has no skill to create distance, so if you have a clear angle, knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive and catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If Garen activates Garen W Courage, delay your crowd control by half a beat.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly right after Garen Q Decisive Strike is used on a minion or its empowered attack is consumed. Build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, but don’t fight for long inside Garen E Judgment. After taking damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next large hit.
Garen.laning: Early on, push or pressure the lane to limit Garen’s chances to build permanent stacks on Garen W Courage. When Garen comes forward to last-hit while he has two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow up with a basic attack. Garen is weak at influencing other lanes, so push the wave and create a numbers advantage elsewhere with your allies.
Garen.phase: From the mid game onward, Tahm Kench’s health items increase his basic attack damage and durability, and Tahm Kench R Devour lets him protect allies. Garen’s stacks from Garen W Courage are permanent, so fighting him becomes more disadvantageous over time. Don’t fight him alone for long.
Garen.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and block Garen’s approach with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour just before Garen’s finishing attack lands. Don’t stay inside Garen E Judgment for long. After taking a large hit, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin to absorb the next one.
Garen.watch: If you engage while Garen Q Decisive Strike is active, its silence makes it hard to fight back. When Garen E Judgment starts, move out of its spin range. Just after Garen activates W Courage, delay Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive by half a beat. If you’re below half health, watch for Garen R Demacian Justice and stay out of its range.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main damage from Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, E Hop / Crunch, and R GNAR! Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don’t focus only on health. Consider tenacity if you’re at high risk of being stunned against a wall.
Gnar.combo: Engage after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down if you have an angle to knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Land two basic attacks to build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, then hit him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as the third stack to stun him. Finish with Tahm Kench R Devour from a safe position.
Gnar.escape: The moment after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down is your chance to engage with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. Delay your engage near walls where Mega Gnar could hit you with R GNAR!, and look for an opening after Mega Gnar ends.
Gnar.fight: Right after Gnar uses E Hop / Crunch, slow him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and close the distance. Avoid a direct fight just after he transforms into Mega Gnar, then fight up close after he returns to Mini Gnar and while he can’t transform again yet.
Gnar.laning: Early on, dodge Mini Gnar’s ranged poke, farm near your turret, and watch his transformation cycle. If Gnar comes forward to last-hit while he has two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow up with a basic attack.
Gnar.phase: The moment Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar is an opportunity to attack. In the mid to late game, Tahm Kench is stronger with health items, so fight while moving with your allies.
Gnar.teamfight: Watch Gnar’s Rage bar and start a fight with your allies just after Mega Gnar ends. Avoid narrow areas and walls. If Gnar uses E Hop / Crunch to get onto your allied carry, protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour, then peel Gnar away with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive.
Gnar.watch: Watch for the slow from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, and dodge Mini Gnar’s boomerang on its return path too. When Mega Gnar is nearby, don’t stand with your back to a wall where Gnar R GNAR! could knock you into it.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen’s main damage, and fit Spectre’s Cowl between your core items. Armor also helps against her physical damage from basic attacks. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Gwen.combo: After Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, knock her up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive and build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. At two stacks, hit her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to apply the third stack and stun her. If you press Tahm Kench R Devour while Q is traveling, you can Devour Gwen from afar as it hits, but only do this if your ally can finish her immediately or you’re in a safe position.
Gwen.escape: Engage with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive just after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t select a target from outside the mist, so check whether you can enter it or wait for it to end before looking for an opening.
Gwen.fight: Trade briefly before Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s stacks build up, and don’t stay in a long fight when they’re full. The moment after Gwen uses E Skip 'n Slash is your chance to catch her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. After taking a large hit, activate Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next hit to gain a shield.
Gwen.laning: If you’ve built two stacks with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, look to stun Gwen with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash when she comes forward to last-hit. Disrupt healing from outside Gwen’s basic attack range, and watch for an escape with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when there are many minions nearby.
Gwen.phase: You can look for short trades before stacks build up. In the mid to late game, as you build health items, Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s stored health increase, so move with your allies.
Gwen.teamfight: Stay next to your allied carry and watch for Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to engage. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour just before Gwen’s finishing attack lands, then peel Gwen away with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Resistance can’t block the true damage in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, so move to dodge it.
Gwen.watch: Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage in the center, so move sideways while she casts it to get out of the center. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target her from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end. After Gwen E Skip 'n Slash closes the gap, watch out for her empowered basic attacks and the healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts.

Illaoi.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t build only health. Prepare Executioner’s Calling when you need to reduce her healing.
Illaoi.combo: Start with a knock-up when Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down and you can land Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Illaoi.escape: Right after baiting Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, look to engage with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. If you also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, engage from the side without tentacles. Save W if you don’t have a clear angle to hit it.
Illaoi.fight: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, bait her into using W Harsh Lesson, then close the distance. Away from walls and tentacles, build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash, and trade while the stacks remain.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and look to last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. If she pulls your spirit, fight back when you can fight. When you choose not to fight, break the tether, then dodge the first tentacle.
Illaoi.phase: While Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don’t give her a target to fight; wait for its duration to end.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group near Illaoi’s tentacles. If you can’t destroy them, draw her away from the walls. When Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson to get onto your allied carry and try to finish them, protect your carry in advance with Tahm Kench R Devour. Then peel Illaoi away from them with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive.
Illaoi.watch: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit when you come forward to last-hit. Illaoi R Leap of Faith deals heavy damage in a short time, so don’t fight her near tentacles; back away instead.

Irelia.build: Build armor and health first. Armor reduces the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Health also helps Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s stored health. Armor can’t reduce the magic damage from Irelia P Ionian Fervor, E Flawless Duet, or R Vanguard’s Edge.
Irelia.combo: After Irelia uses Q Bladesurge, knock her up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive if you’re sure it will hit, then build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. At two stacks, look to apply the third stack and stun her with your next Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If you have an angle to Devour her from afar, press Tahm Kench R Devour while that Q is traveling.
Irelia.escape: The moment after you bait Irelia into using Q Bladesurge is your window to engage. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, close the distance with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If W misses, you lose your engage and escape for a while, so only use it when you can land it.
Irelia.fight: The moment after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the distance. Slow her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or knock her up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. After taking damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next large hit.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and take a step back when minions are about to die. If she comes forward to last-hit while she has two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, stun her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow up with a basic attack.
Irelia.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build health items, both Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s stored health increase, so stay close to your allies.
Irelia.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for Irelia Q Bladesurge to connect. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour just before Irelia’s finishing skill hits, then peel Irelia away with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and E Flawless Duet have a major impact in team fights, so focus Irelia with your allies.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain dashes through low-health minions to approach, so back away when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped by Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.

Jax.build: Jax deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on just one type of resistance. Basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, so consider items that reduce attack speed first. If his magic damage is especially threatening, fit Spectre’s Cowl between your core items. Avoid stacking only large amounts of health because Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, build three stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with Tahm Kench’s basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. Then stun him with Q Tongue Lash and use Tahm Kench R Devour from a safe position. At two stacks, you can also press R while Q Tongue Lash is traveling to look for a ranged Devour.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax uses Q Leap Strike is your chance to close the distance, since he has no movement ability left. After the stun from Jax E Counter Strike also ends, chain crowd control by engaging with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. While Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move out of stun range.
Jax.fight: Trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If he has also used Q Leap Strike, that’s a chance to engage with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, but only use it when you can land it.
Jax.laning: When Jax comes forward to last-hit while he has two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash.
Jax.phase: In the mid to late game, Tahm Kench’s health items and E Thick Skin become powerful, so move with your allies instead of trying to finish the fight alone.
Jax.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for Jax Q Leap Strike to engage. Protect your carry with Tahm Kench R Devour before a finishing attack hits, then peel Jax away with the slow from Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive. While Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t group nearby or basic attack him. Focus your crowd control after the stun ends.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move outside its area stun. Jax can reach you with Q Leap Strike, so save Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive for the Counter Strike that may follow his leap.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance doesn’t reduce the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, so don’t rely on it and take the hit. Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate also deals damage based on your maximum health, so consider movement speed to leave the marked area instead of stacking a lot of health.
Jayce.combo: After Jayce’s leap is down, knock him up by emerging beneath him with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive when you can land it. If he’s at two stacks and has created distance, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling to look for a ranged Devour.
Jayce.escape: Engage just after Jayce’s Hammer Stance Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast leap is down. If he has also used Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate’s knockback, it’s a good time to close in with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If W misses, you lose your engage and escape for a while, so only use it when you can land it.
Jayce.fight: The moment after Jayce leaps with Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast in Hammer Stance is your chance to close the distance. Slow him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. At two stacks, hit him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to stun him, then use Tahm Kench R Devour when you can finish him safely.
Jayce.laning: While Jayce is strong early, farm defensively and dodge Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast in Cannon Stance by moving side to side. Don’t force an engage without stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste. If Jayce comes forward to last-hit while he has two stacks, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. When health has been reduced, use Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to heal, but don’t stay in lane recklessly.
Jayce.phase: Farm defensively and hold on through this phase.
Jayce.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for Jayce to engage. If Jayce dives onto your carry with Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast in Hammer Stance, protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before his finishing attack lands. Then peel Jayce away with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, and attack Jayce with your allies once his leap is down.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce places Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate in Cannon Stance, Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast may follow, so dodge sideways out of its line. In Hammer Stance, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. After taking a large hit, activate Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next attack to gain a shield.

Kayle.build: Build magic resist against Kayle’s magic damage, fitting Spectre’s Cowl between core items. Magic resist improves Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s damage-storage efficiency and your survival time. Avoid Kayle Q Radiant Blast so it does not reduce your resistances.
Kayle.combo: If you’ve reached Kayle, build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with two basic attacks, land the third with Q Tongue Lash to stun her, then follow with R Devour. When you have a reliable angle, engage with W Abyssal Dive to knock her up, then build stacks with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. If Kayle has two stacks and moves away, press R Devour while Q Tongue Lash is traveling to try for a long-range swallow.
Kayle.escape: Good chances to engage are after dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast’s slow or after she has used Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed. Then catch her with the slow or stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, or the knockup from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive if you can reliably hit it. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is down, start a fight with your allies without waiting out her invulnerability.
Kayle.fight: Build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash, then stun Kayle with Q Tongue Lash while she still has two stacks.
Kayle.laning: Don’t force trades without Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks. If Kayle steps up to last-hit while she has two stacks, stun her with Q Tongue Lash and follow with basic attacks. Kayle can use W Celestial Blessing to gain movement speed and escape, so coordinate with your jungler to land crowd control first.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a path to reach Kayle from the flank or out of vision, timed with your allies’ crowd control, so she can’t keep attacking from the backline. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, lock her down with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive, then deal damage after her invulnerability ends. If your allied carry is in danger, protect them first with Tahm Kench R Devour, then use Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive to peel enemies away.
Kayle.watch: Avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces resistances. When your health is low, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which scales with missing health. After taking heavy damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next attack lands. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your damage and use Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or W Abyssal Dive to lock her down until her invulnerability ends.

Kled.build: Kled’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste’s basic attack damage scales with bonus health, but Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! also scale with your max health, so be careful about stacking a lot of health alone. If crowd control gets you killed, prioritize tenacity. Lowering attack speed can also buy you more time before Kled finishes all four hits of W Violent Tendencies.
Kled.combo: Build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with two basic attacks, then land the third with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to stun him. After that, use Tahm Kench R Devour when you can finish the enemy from a safe position. If an enemy with two stacks moves away, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling to try for a long-range swallow.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage just because Kled E Jousting is down. If Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is also down and you’ve dodged the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, you have a chance to catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive leaves you exposed for a long time if it misses, so use it when you can hit.
Kled.fight: Don’t force engages early; keep your distance and poke with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Trade with basic attacks while Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks remain, and stun Kled with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash once you have two stacks. If you’re about to take all of Kled W Violent Tendencies’ consecutive attacks, back away and fight again later.
Kled.phase: Early on, Tahm Kench is not much of a threat before he builds stacks, so focus on not giving Kled an advantage. Kled gets weaker after the laning phase and midgame, so move with your allies in the late game.
Kled.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for Kled E Jousting or R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! to engage. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour as soon as Kled reaches them, then peel him away with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knockup from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from far away, so keep vision on the flanks and don’t let Tahm Kench get taken out first in front.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, beware of the fourth basic attack’s damage based on your max health, and retreat before taking all four hits. If Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are both available, he can catch you in succession, so manage your distance first.

Malphite.build: Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force deal magic damage, so build magic resist first. Fitting Spectre’s Cowl between core items increases your survival time and helps you use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s reserve, which builds in proportion to damage taken.
Malphite.combo: First break Malphite P Granite Shield, then build two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Land the next Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as the third stack to stun him, then follow with Tahm Kench R Devour if you can swallow the enemy from a safe position. Against an enemy with two stacks, you can also press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tongue Lash is traveling to try for a long-range swallow.
Malphite.escape: While Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, he has no other movement ability, so you can engage with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive leaves you without an engage or escape tool for a long time if it misses, so use it when you can hit.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then trade while Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks remain. After taking heavy damage, convert Tahm Kench E Thick Skin into a shield just before the next hit lands.
Malphite.laning: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, keep poking at short intervals so it can’t regenerate. If he steps up to last-hit while he has two stacks, look to stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Malphite Q Seismic Shard can’t be dodged from behind minions, so don’t stay in range for long.
Malphite.phase: In the mid to late game, Tahm Kench’s health items increase both his basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s reserve, so play alongside your allies.
Malphite.teamfight: Stay near your allied carry and keep some distance from them. Protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour just before Malphite R Unstoppable Force reaches them. Then peel Malphite away from your carry with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knockup from W Abyssal Dive. Counterattack with your allies right after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down.
Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it difficult to engage or retreat, so don’t start a trade right after being hit. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t be interrupted by crowd control, so don’t group tightly with allies when you don’t know where he is, and avoid giving him an angle to charge.

Mordekaiser.build: Mordekaiser’s main damage is magic, so build magic resist first and fit Spectre’s Cowl between core items. Build some armor against his basic attack damage too, but beware of stacking a lot of health alone because Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise scales with max health. Anti-healing to reduce Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s healing is also valuable.
Mordekaiser.combo: After Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, if you can hit with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, knock him up and build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If he has two stacks, land the next Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as the third hit to stun him, then follow with Tahm Kench R Devour. Against Mordekaiser with two stacks, you can also press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling to swallow him from range.
Mordekaiser.escape: Mordekaiser has no mobility, so after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses, you have a chance to catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. However, don’t engage if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready and you’re separated from your allies. After Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, create distance while slowing him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash.
Mordekaiser.fight: Trade briefly before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, then create distance with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. After Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses, look for an angle to hit with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive and engage. Don’t dump your damage right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield activates; focus him after the shield is worn down or converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: If Mordekaiser steps up to last-hit while he has two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and add a basic attack. After taking damage, use the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before burst damage lands after a heavy hit.
Mordekaiser.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build health items, Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s reserve both grow, so fight alongside your allies.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and spread out so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp doesn’t pull multiple allies in together. If your carry is in danger, protect them early with Tahm Kench R Devour, then peel Mordekaiser away with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knockup from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive after spitting them out. Use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin after storing damage, just before the next heavy hit lands.
Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, you’re likely to be hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and basic attacks afterward, so keep your distance when facing him. Trade only once or twice before backing off, before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter his range alone, where you can’t get help from allies.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main damage. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor, so leaving its area takes priority. If you’re taking most of your damage from the magic damage of Nasus E Spirit Fire and R Fury of the Sands, fit Spectre’s Cowl between core items.
Nasus.combo: If you can get close, build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with two basic attacks, then land the third with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to stun him. Then use Tahm Kench R Devour from a safe position when your allies can immediately attack Nasus. If Nasus has two stacks and moves away, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling to try for a long-range swallow.
Nasus.escape: Nasus W Wither being down is a good window to approach. Nasus has no skill to create distance on his own, so catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive from an angle where you can reliably hit. Don’t overextend after him while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.fight: Don’t force trades when you have no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks. Build stacks, then stun Nasus with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and add basic attacks when he steps up to last-hit. Don’t face him for long while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Afterward, let the wave come toward you and pressure Nasus so he can’t comfortably last-hit under his turret with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Nasus has no escape tool besides Flash, so look for chances to call your jungler for a gank.
Nasus.phase: Pressure Nasus’s last-hits while he is weak early to delay Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks. As the game goes on, his stacks make him harder to fight, so move with your allies in the mid to late game and make use of Tahm Kench’s ability to protect them.
Nasus.teamfight: Rather than meeting Nasus head-on, create distance near your allied carry with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knockup from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If Nasus reaches your carry and they’re in danger, protect them early with Tahm Kench R Devour. While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, let the fight pass unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more threatening as it stacks, so pressure him from the start to make last-hitting difficult. Nasus W Wither reduces your movement and attack speed, so don’t push far in alone. Nasus gets stronger when Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, so create distance and wait it out unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and basic attacks. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that resistances can’t reduce, so build health as well. Bonus health also adds to Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with two basic attacks, then land the third with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to stun him. If he has two stacks, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Q is traveling to swallow him from range as it hits. Tahm Kench is also vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so use it when your allies can finish them immediately or from a safe position.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no skill to create distance on his own, so right after Olaf R Ragnarok ends is your chance to engage with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. Don’t engage while R is active expecting movement impairments to work; create distance behind a wall or your allies instead.
Olaf.fight: Olaf gains attack speed and healing as his health gets lower, so don’t engage carelessly just because he’s at half health. While Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks remain, trade with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. After taking heavy damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next hit lands.
Olaf.laning: Move away from where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands to prevent him from picking it back up. If Olaf has two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash when he steps up to last-hit. Even at low health, beware of Olaf’s bonus attack speed and healing.
Olaf.phase: In the mid to late game, health items increase Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and survivability, so move with your allies.
Olaf.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for Olaf to engage. Protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour before the finishing damage reaches them. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait it out. After R ends, peel Olaf away from your carry with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, so move in the opposite direction from where the axe lands to prevent him from picking it back up. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, which armor can’t reduce, so endure it with Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s shield or the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash after taking damage. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, movement impairments won’t work, so create distance. After it ends, catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or W Abyssal Dive.

Ornn.build: Ornn deals both physical and magic damage, so consider tenacity first, then build both armor and magic resistance. Health also helps Tahm Kench's basic attack damage, but don't stack only health because Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your max health.
Ornn.combo: When you can safely get close, build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with two basic attacks, then stun with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as your third hit. Follow with Tahm Kench R Devour, but first make sure an ally can attack immediately or you're somewhere safe, such as under your turret. Use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to engage only when you can reliably hit Ornn.
Ornn.escape: Don't engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge alone is down. Your window is when Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also down, before it becomes available again; pressure him then with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Ornn.fight: Avoid walls and pillars as you manage your distance so you don't get hit by Ornn's tools for catching you in succession. Trade with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash when you have stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste; don't force an engage without stacks. Pressure Ornn with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is available again.
Ornn.laning: When Ornn has two stacks and steps up to last-hit, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack. If Ornn tries to forge an item, stay on him and attack to interrupt the forge.
Ornn.phase: Get ahead in lane and pressure Ornn before his items and allied masterwork upgrades accumulate.
Ornn.teamfight: Stay near your carry and watch for the moment Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God hit. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before the finishing attack lands, then peel Ornn off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Also move out of the line between the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn.
Ornn.watch: Stay away from the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls. Ornn E Searing Charge knocks you up if it hits terrain, so move toward open ground when you see him prepare it. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance until the effect ends to avoid the extra damage and long crowd control.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Tahm Kench can also increase his basic attack damage with bonus health, but Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, and Pantheon R Grand Starfall has armor penetration, so don't rely on health or armor alone.
Pantheon.combo: If the target has two stacks, queue up R Devour while Q Tongue Lash is traveling so you can swallow them from range as Q applies the third stack. Tahm Kench is vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so only use it where an ally can finish them immediately or where you're safe.
Pantheon.escape: The window to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. Close in with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive, but use W Abyssal Dive only when you can land it.
Pantheon.fight: Early on, avoid trading head-on with Pantheon. Trade when you have stacks of P An Acquired Taste. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait for it to end or move to the side instead of using abilities from the front. After taking heavy damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next hit lands.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear. When Pantheon has two stacks of P An Acquired Taste and steps up to last-hit, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow up with basic attacks.
Pantheon.phase: In the mid and late game, stay with your team.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stay near your carry and watch for Pantheon W Shield Vault or an engage with R Grand Starfall. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before the finishing attack lands, then peel Pantheon off with the slow from Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so be careful not to enter its range. Pantheon Q Comet Spear deals less damage if it hits you through a minion. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage. Tahm Kench can increase his basic attack damage with health, but be careful about stacking only large amounts of health because Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health. Don't spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: If Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with two basic attacks, then stun with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as your third hit. If Poppy has two stacks and is at a distance, queue up Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling to swallow her from range. Tahm Kench is vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so only use it somewhere safe or when an ally can finish her immediately.
Poppy.escape: Right after you bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the distance. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait for it to end, then engage with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Don't engage from the front while Poppy charges R Keeper's Verdict; dodge to the side.
Poppy.fight: Keep your distance, then slow Poppy with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and build stacks right after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't jump in with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive; wait for its duration to end. After taking damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next heavy hit lands.
Poppy.laning: When Poppy has two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste and steps up to last-hit, stun her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack. When Poppy's thrown shield drops, watch her path to retrieve it and step on it first to deny the shield.
Poppy.phase: In the mid and late game, as health items accumulate, your basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin's reserve both increase, so fight alongside your team.
Poppy.teamfight: Stay near your carry and watch for the moment Poppy E Heroic Charge hits. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before the finishing attack lands. Then peel Poppy away from your carry with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Hold your position so Tahm Kench doesn't go down first at the front.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you against a wall, so stay in open space instead of backing up to a wall. If you get hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second hit detonates. When Poppy charges R Keeper's Verdict and spins her hammer, move out of the way to the side.

Quinn.build: The damage from Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault is all physical, so build armor first. After that, health increases Tahm Kench's durability and the damage of his basic attacks with Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste.
Quinn.combo: If Quinn E Vault is down, knock her up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Stun her by landing Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as the third stack, then use Tahm Kench R Devour when you can safely finish her. If Quinn has two stacks and is far away, queue up Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling to try to swallow her.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is her only escape, so right after she uses it is a window for Tahm Kench to engage. Slow her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or engage with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, but use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive only when you can land it.
Quinn.fight: Slow Quinn with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or close the distance with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive right after Quinn E Vault is down. Once you're close, build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, but avoid forcing a trade when you have no stacks.
Quinn.laning: Early on, Quinn's range advantage puts you at a disadvantage, so preserve your health while farming. If Quinn P Harrier marks you, back off and let it expire; farm when you aren't marked. Start a trade when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives.
Quinn.phase: Quinn is strong in the early laning phase because of her range advantage, so Tahm Kench should preserve his health and endure. In the mid and late game, as health items accumulate, Tahm Kench is strong when fighting with his team.
Quinn.teamfight: Stay near your carry and watch for Quinn's flank. If Quinn E Vault hits your carry and puts them in danger, protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour. Then peel Quinn off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move beyond Quinn's basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind a line of minions, and don't rush to throw Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash if your vision is reduced. Quinn E Vault interrupts Tahm Kench's approach and marks you, so don't force an engage before it's down.

Renekton.build: Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Tahm Kench also gets more magic damage on his basic attacks and more stored health for Tahm Kench E Thick Skin from health, so get some health too. Armor won't block the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus, and your priority against the armor reduction from empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice is positioning to dodge the dash.
Renekton.combo: Build two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with two basic attacks, then hit Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to apply the third stack and stun Renekton. If you're in a safe spot to swallow him, queue up Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling so you swallow Renekton as it hits. If you start with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, do so when Renekton E Slice and Dice is down and you're sure you can land it.
Renekton.escape: Right after you bait out Renekton E Slice and Dice is your window to engage. In particular, if Renekton used Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage and has also used Renekton W Ruthless Predator, chase with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton is out of Fury, and counterattack right after he uses Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, slow him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to close the distance.
