Use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin after damage has built up as gray health, just before the next heavy hit lands.
Renekton.laning: Don't stand in or behind your minion wave, so Renekton E Slice and Dice can't use your minions as a stepping stone to engage. If you have two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, look to apply the third stack and stun Renekton with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash when he steps up to last-hit.
Renekton.phase: Avoid fighting while Renekton R Dominus is active, deny him kills, and keep farming. Renekton's value falls from the mid game onward, while Tahm Kench gets stronger in the mid and late game as he builds health items, so move with your team.
Renekton.teamfight: Stay near your carry and watch for Renekton to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Protect your ally in advance with Tahm Kench R Devour just before Renekton can finish them. After spitting your ally out, peel Renekton off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin after damage has built up, timing it for the next burst.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is above or near half, watch out for the empowered stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator breaks Tahm Kench E Thick Skin's shield first, so don't try to block his first combo with the shield.

Riven.build: Riven deals physical damage, so build armor first. Also get health to reduce the chance of being caught at low health by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: Engage after Riven Q Broken Wings is down, when you can reliably knock her up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Build stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks, then land Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to apply the third stack and stun her. Follow with Tahm Kench R Devour if you can finish her from a safe position.
Riven.escape: Don't rush to engage when only Riven E Valor is down; she can escape with Riven Q Broken Wings. Engage with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive when Riven Q Broken Wings has been fully spent and Riven W Ki Burst is also down.
Riven.fight: Don't waste Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive before Riven engages. Use them as she comes in to interrupt her follow-up attacks. If Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, look to trade while building stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste. After taking heavy damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next attack lands.
Riven.laning: After Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions, build stacks with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If she has two stacks and steps up to last-hit, try to stun her with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash.
Riven.phase: In the mid and late game, when you have more health items, Tahm Kench's basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin's value increase, so move with your team.
Riven.teamfight: Stay beside your carry and watch for Riven to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before Riven's finishing attack lands, then peel her off with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Riven.watch: Riven can close the distance from far away by chaining Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, so back away as soon as you see the first dash. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range increases and her finishing damage gets stronger as the target's health gets lower, so keep your distance until its duration ends.

Rumble.build: Rumble's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. Fit Spectre's Cowl between core items to give yourself time to make use of the stored health from Tahm Kench E Thick Skin. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking only health.
Rumble.combo: After Rumble W Scrap Shield expires, knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive when you can land the engage. Follow with Tahm Kench R Devour if you can finish him immediately from a safe position.
Rumble.escape: Before the second shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon arrives, you can use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to create distance. Look to engage after Rumble E Electro Harpoon is down and Rumble W Scrap Shield has expired. Rumble has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him then with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Rumble.fight: Avoid fights where you take Rumble Q Flamespitter for a long time, and start trades where Rumble has to walk forward. If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, don't commit heavy damage while the shield is up; wait briefly. After the shield expires, slow him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and mix in basic attacks to build stacks of P An Acquired Taste.
Rumble.laning: If Rumble steps forward to last-hit while there are two stacks, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack. If health has decreased, use Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to heal. After taking damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next heavy hit lands.
Rumble.phase: In the mid and late game, when you have more health items, your basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin's stored health increase, so move with your team.
Rumble.teamfight: Stay near your carry and protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour before Rumble's attack lands. If the position is dangerous after swallowing your ally, escape with them using Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. Then peel Rumble off your carry with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your max health while he's close to you, so manage your distance to avoid taking it for long. If you get hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, back away before the second shot or escape with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If both shots hit, the slow gets stronger and your magic resistance is reduced.

Sett.build: Build armor first against Sett's basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Health increases both Tahm Kench's basic attack magic damage and his durability, but Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your max health, so don't focus too heavily on stacking health. Sett W Haymaker's center deals true damage, which resistances can't reduce, so sidestep it.
Sett.combo: When Sett's crowd control is down and you can land it, knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then build two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and hit Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash as the third stack to stun him. Follow with Tahm Kench R Devour if an ally can finish Sett immediately after you swallow him or you're somewhere safe, such as under your turret. If Sett has two stacks, queue up Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling to try to swallow him from range.
Sett.escape: The window to engage is while Sett R The Show Stopper is down. If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive misses, engaging or disengaging afterward is difficult, so use it when you can land it.
Sett.fight: Pressure Sett with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash while stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste are active. After dealing damage, briefly back off to respect Sett W Haymaker, then fight again once his Grit has faded.
Sett.laning: If Sett has two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste when he steps up to last-hit, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack. Use Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to poke and heal, but choose your timing when you have enough stacks to stun. Avoid standing on the opposite side of Sett from the minions so Sett E Facebreaker can't stun you.
Sett.phase: In the mid and late game, health items increase Tahm Kench's basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin's stored health, so move with your team.
Sett.teamfight: Stay near your carry and watch for an engage with Sett R The Show Stopper. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before Sett's finishing ability lands. Then peel Sett off your carry with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. After taking heavy damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next burst lands.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger right after Sett takes damage, so if you've dealt damage, back away and sidestep the center of its aim. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of him, so don't position with Sett between you and the minion wave. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, so be mindful of where you'll be thrown when Sett has R available.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity against Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so build resistances without leaning too heavily toward either one. Health also helps Tahm Kench deal damage, but Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.combo: If Shen E Shadow Dash is down and Shen W Spirit’s Refuge has ended, use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to knock Shen up when you can land it reliably. Follow with two basic attacks to stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, then hit him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash for the third stack and a stun before using Tahm Kench R Devour. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is still active, it will block your basic attacks, so don’t rush this sequence.
Shen.escape: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to engage. If Shen R Stand United is also unavailable, you can catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If only Shen E Shadow Dash is down, he can still escape with Shen R Stand United, so check before engaging.
Shen.fight: Trade back right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, don’t try to stack your passive with basic attacks; after it ends, use basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash to stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste. After taking damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next big hit lands.
Shen.laning: When Shen steps up to last-hit while your stacks are still active, pressure him with the threat of a Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash stun and take control of the lane. If Shen leaves lane with Shen R Stand United, alert your team and get value from the empty lane.
Shen.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build health items, Tahm Kench’s basic attack damage and the stored amount from Tahm Kench E Thick Skin both increase, so move with your allies.
Shen.teamfight: Stay near your allied carry and prepare for Shen to engage with Shen E Shadow Dash. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before a lethal hit lands. After spitting them out, use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to keep Shen away. Watch for Shen to join with Shen R Stand United and alert your team.
Shen.watch: If Shen taunts you with Shen E Shadow Dash, you will take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash first. Also move out of the path of his spirit blade as it returns to him. Tahm Kench's basic attacks are negated inside Shen W Spirit's Refuge, so delay trading basic attacks until the zone ends.

Sion.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. However, avoid Sion E Roar of the Slayer first, since it reduces your armor. Also, keep in mind that Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Sion.combo: After Sion Q Decimating Smash or R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, engage with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to knock him up if you can land it reliably. Stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste three times with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, then stun him with your next Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and use Tahm Kench R Devour from a safe position. If you already have two stacks, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is in flight to look for a long-range swallow.
Sion.escape: When Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, you have an opening to engage. Make Sion use Sion Q Decimating Smash early or dodge it to the side, then catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive. If Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive misses, engaging and disengaging will be difficult for a while, so only use it when you can land it.
Sion.fight: Make Sion use Sion Q Decimating Smash early or dodge it to the side, then trade while stacking your passive. If Sion activates Sion W Soul Furnace, focus your damage before the shield bursts to try to break it. While Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, it’s a good time to catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive.
Sion.laning: Build up Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks in advance, then hit Sion with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash for the third stack and a stun when he steps forward to last-hit. If Sion keeps killing units, his maximum health will grow, so disrupt his farming or get value in other lanes.
Sion.phase: Sion's maximum health also keeps growing as he kills units, so disrupt his farming or get value in other lanes.
Sion.teamfight: Stay near your allied carry and use Tahm Kench R Devour to protect them just before Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught hits. Then use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive to keep Sion away from your carry. If Sion goes down, reposition until Sion P Glory in Death ends.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash gains a knock-up and stun when charged, so move to the side as soon as he starts charging it. Don't meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side of his approach. Even after you take Sion down, Sion P Glory in Death lets him revive and attack quickly, so don't keep fighting there—reposition and create distance.

Teemo.build: Teemo’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. Fitting Spectre’s Cowl between your core items helps you stay alive longer and make use of the damage stored by Tahm Kench E Thick Skin.
Teemo.combo: After Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, if you can land Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, knock him up with W, then use basic attack → Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash → basic attack to stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste three times and follow with Tahm Kench R Devour. If you already have two stacks, press R while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is in flight to look for a long-range swallow as Q hits.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, you have a chance to engage while stacking your passive with basic attacks. If Teemo is using Teemo W Move Quick to create distance, engage when you have a clear angle to land Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive; save W if you can’t land it.
Teemo.fight: Start trading right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. If you aren’t ready to engage, stay outside Teemo’s basic attack range. When you go in, close the distance with the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then stay on him.
Teemo.laning: Avoid taking one of Teemo’s basic attacks and retreating. When Teemo steps up to last-hit while your stacks are still active, look for a Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash stun. Don’t walk straight through a bush without vision; check it with a Control Ward or go around.
Teemo.phase: If you give Teemo too much time, he’ll stack traps, so push the lane and pressure him with your allied jungler.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap from key paths, and expect traps around objectives and in narrow passages. Stay near your allied carry and protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour just before a threat reaches them, then use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to keep enemies away.
Teemo.watch: After Teemo Q Blinding Dart hits, your basic attacks are negated, making it hard to stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with them. While blinded, respond with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or back off, and avoid trades where you take one basic attack empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot and briefly retreat. Also watch for Teemo’s stealth in bushes without vision and Teemo R Noxious Trap near objective paths.

Trundle.build: Prioritize armor against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Armor can’t block the damage from Trundle R Subjugate, and it also steals resistances, so don’t try to withstand a direct fight by stacking health or resistances alone. Effects that reduce attack speed also help reduce the damage from Trundle’s basic attacks.
Trundle.combo: When you can land it reliably, knock Trundle up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive and then stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks. If you already have two stacks, hit him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash for the third stack and a stun, then follow with Tahm Kench R Devour when the position is safe and your allies can finish him immediately. Don’t engage first if Trundle E Pillar of Ice is still available or you’re likely to miss W.
Trundle.escape: You have an opening to engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and Trundle W Frozen Domain has ended. Trundle has no ability that creates distance on its own, so catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash then, and knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive if you can land it reliably.
Trundle.fight: Don’t force an engage when you have no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks. Back out of Trundle W Frozen Domain, then build stacks; when you have two stacks, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash for a short trade. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, don’t keep fighting him head-on—create distance.
Trundle.laning: Poke with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and when Trundle steps up to last-hit with two stacks on him, get value from a Q stun and a basic attack. Trundle P King’s Tribute heals him when nearby units die, so don’t merely chip away at his health and let the lane drag on; take your advantage immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.phase: In the mid to late game, Tahm Kench’s health items and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin become more valuable, so set up team fights with your allies around objectives.
Trundle.teamfight: Stay near your allied carry and watch for Trundle to approach. Protect your carry with Tahm Kench R Devour before they’re in danger, then use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to keep Trundle away. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, don’t stand in front of him alone; focus on another target or create distance.
Trundle.watch: Inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, his attack speed and movement speed increase, so don’t fight him; back out and wait for it to end. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape and slows you, so avoid narrow paths and immediately move to the side when a pillar appears. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on your maximum health and steals resistances, so create distance while it’s active.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Thornmail is also effective because he relies heavily on basic attacks. Tahm Kench can increase both durability and basic attack damage with health items.
Tryndamere.combo: After Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive and use two basic attacks to stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste. Then hit him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash for the third stack and a stun, and swallow him with Tahm Kench R Devour. Tahm Kench is vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so use it from a safe position.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after you make Tryndamere use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, you have a chance to engage.
Tryndamere.fight: Don’t force an engage when you have no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks. If you have two stacks, stun Tryndamere with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and add a basic attack when he steps up to last-hit. Create distance while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, then deal damage again after it ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere to make last-hitting difficult and prevent him from building Fury. If he starts hitting minions to build Fury, create distance in preparation for his approach. When health has decreased, sustain with healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin used after taking damage.
Tryndamere.phase: Don’t try to hold a side lane alone against Tryndamere while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available; respond with your allies.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Stay near your allied carry and wait for Tryndamere to engage with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Once he reaches your carry, protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour, then use Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to keep Tryndamere away. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, use crowd control to run out its duration.
Tryndamere.watch: As Tryndamere hits minions and builds Fury, his critical strikes and healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust become stronger, so create distance before he gets close. If Tryndamere engages with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, interrupt him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.

Udyr.build: Prioritize armor against Udyr’s main damage. If the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm is a serious threat and the enemy team’s damage is mostly magic, fit Spectre’s Cowl between your core items. Keep in mind that Udyr deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr uses Udyr E Blazing Stampede, knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede is his only mobility tool, so right after you make him use it is Tahm Kench’s chance to engage. While Udyr’s E is awakened, immobilizing effects won’t work, so wait until it ends before landing a Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash stun or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. You can also counterattack right after taking a stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Udyr.fight: Take one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then counterattack. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, pressure him without giving him time to heal. After taking damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin to convert the stored damage into a shield just before the next big hit lands.
Udyr.laning: Early on, Tahm Kench is not much of a threat before he stacks Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, so avoid forced trades. Udyr can appear from the jungle for a gank, so keep vision on key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t step forward when he’s out of sight. When trading, stack your passive with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, then look for a stun by landing Q with the third stack.
Udyr.phase: Even then, move with your allies instead of trying to finish the fight alone.
Udyr.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for Udyr to engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before lethal damage lands. Once Udyr’s awakened E ends, use Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to keep him away from your carry. Instead of forcing a fight against Udyr while he’s made tanky by defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, take out the weaker enemies behind him first, then fight with a numbers advantage.
Udyr.watch: Udyr can run in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun the first target he hits, so keep your distance right after he activates a new E. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, and R also slows in an area, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight with him.

Urgot.build: Build armor first to withstand Urgot’s main damage. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stack health alone; consider both armor and total health. Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste also adds basic attack damage based on bonus health, so you have less need to buy separate offensive items.
Urgot.combo: After Urgot E Disdain is down, knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If he already has two stacks, you can also press R while Q is traveling to Devour him from range as Q hits.
Urgot.escape: Go in right after baiting Urgot E Disdain. His only mobility tool is down, so you can close the gap and catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge has already hit you, it’ll be hard to walk away, so decide immediately whether to fight back where you are.
Urgot.fight: The longer you stay near Urgot, the more damage his leg cannons stack up, so don’t fight him head-on for long when there are no stacks. Urgot E Disdain is your chance to close the gap right after it’s down. Catch him then with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, and weave in basic attacks to stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste.
Urgot.laning: Poke and heal with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash from outside Urgot’s short range. When you have two stacks and Urgot steps up to last-hit, look for a Q stun. Use the distance and walls to make it hard for Urgot E Disdain to hit you. If a straight-up fight is too difficult, take him down with your jungler.
Urgot.phase: Focus on farming early, since Tahm Kench’s threat from passive stacks is low and melee champions struggle to beat Urgot head-on. In the mid to late game, as you build health items, your basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s stored gray health increase, so move with your allies.
Urgot.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and deny Urgot E Disdain an angle to engage. If E is about to hit your carry, protect them in advance with Tahm Kench R Devour. After swallowing an ally, you can use Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to get them out of danger. Then use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W’s knock-up to keep Urgot away from your carry.
Urgot.watch: If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it heavily slows you and makes you a target for his W, so dodge it as it comes in. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of Urgot’s range before your health reaches the execute threshold.

Volibear.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. His damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so consider an item that reduces attack speed. Grievous Wounds helps against Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing, and Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on maximum health, so be wary of stacking health alone.
Volibear.combo: Engage when Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive can reliably knock him up, then stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash. Hit Volibear with two stacks with Q Tongue Lash to look for a stun. If he can be swallowed, press Tahm Kench R Devour while Q is traveling. Tahm Kench is also vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so use it when your allies can finish them immediately or when you’re in a safe spot.
Volibear.escape: Go in when the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down and Volibear R Stormbringer is unavailable. In particular, catch him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and W Abyssal Dive before R Stormbringer comes back up.
Volibear.fight: Don’t take a fight while Volibear approaches with stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm; engage after they wear off. Build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks and Q Tongue Lash to set up a stun. After taking heavy damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next hit lands to gain a shield.
Volibear.laning: If Volibear steps up to last-hit while he has two stacks on him, stun him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and follow with a basic attack. Even when you’re low and holding near your turret, keep in mind that Volibear R Stormbringer can disable the turret briefly.
Volibear.phase: Tahm Kench is strong in the mid to late game as he builds health items, so move with your allies.
Volibear.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for Volibear’s engages with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer. When Volibear reaches your carry, protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour, then use the slow from Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from W Abyssal Dive to keep him away. If Volibear P The Relentless Storm already has stacks, don’t take a head-on fight in that state.
Volibear.watch: When Volibear approaches with Volibear Q Thundering Smash active, watch out for the empowered basic attack stun and wait outside his attack range. If you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, walk to the side to avoid its damage and slow. Volibear W Frenzied Maul leads to healing, so if you can’t finish him, back off and wait for the next fight. Don’t stay under your turret at low health while Volibear R Stormbringer is available.

Yone.build: Tahm Kench can increase both his durability and basic attack damage with health items, so consider building them first. However, Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, and Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t stack health alone; build both resistances. Attack speed reduction also helps slow the cooldowns of Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone W Spirit Cleave.
Yone.combo: When you can reliably hit him, knock him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If he has two stacks, apply the third and stun him with the next Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, then follow with Tahm Kench R Devour. To swallow Yone from range, confirm he has two stacks, then press Tahm Kench R Devour while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is traveling.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is down. Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are also ways for him to escape, so look for an opening especially before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. If Yone engages in his spirit form first, stun or knock him up with Tahm Kench to prevent his return.
Yone.fight: Don’t engage while Yone’s tornado on Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready. After Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, you can prevent his return by stunning him with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or knocking him up with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. After taking damage, use Tahm Kench E Thick Skin just before the next big hit to turn your stored gray health into a shield.
Yone.laning: Stop pressuring and keep your distance when Yone’s tornado on Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready.
Yone.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build health items, your basic attack damage and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s stored gray health increase, so move with your allies.
Yone.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and watch for Yone to engage with Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, or Yone R Fate Sealed. Protect your ally with Tahm Kench R Devour before the finishing damage lands, then use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to keep Yone away from your carry. Keep your distance from your allies so several of you aren’t hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave together.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, stay out of range until the stacks disappear. If he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal additional damage when he returns, so if you’re low on health, heal in advance with Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or create distance. If you stand alone behind the path of Yone R Fate Sealed, Yone will enter that position, so watch your positioning.

Yorick.build: Build armor first to withstand Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ damage. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on maximum health, so think carefully before stacking health alone. If the enemy team’s damage is mostly magic, fit Spectre’s Cowl between your core items.
Yorick.combo: When you can land it reliably, knock up the target with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, then stack Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Tahm Kench is vulnerable while swallowing an enemy, so use it when you’re in a safe spot or your allies can finish them immediately.
Yorick.escape: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist and go in while Yorick W Dark Procession is down. If Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive misses, you lose both your engage and escape tool for a long time, so use it only when you can reliably hit Yorick.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, start trading where there are few graves and Mist Walkers. Build Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks with basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, then stun him with Q at two stacks. Yorick has no ability to create distance on his own, so keep pressuring him with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive and Q once you’ve caught him.
Yorick.phase: When Yorick is pushing a side lane, consider whether you and your allies can take an objective elsewhere.
Yorick.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and protect them with Tahm Kench R Devour just before an enemy finishing ability lands. Then use the slow from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to peel approaching enemies away. If you can clear Yorick’s Mist Walkers first, do so to reduce Yorick’s damage.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you, and deals damage based on maximum health, so watch its trajectory and dodge it. If the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself and clear the Mist Walkers first. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, you can attack the wall to break it.
